title: Federal final income tax return after death
facts: A deceased person's final federal individual income tax return generally reports income and deductions through the date of death.
The final Form 1040 or 1040-SR is generally due on the same filing schedule that would have applied if the person had lived.
A surviving spouse or personal representative may sign and file the return under applicable IRS procedures.
Income received after death may belong on an estate, beneficiary or other taxpayer return rather than the decedent's final individual return.
